versions.changelog: Fix: Declare required credentials (COOKIDOO_EMAIL, COOKIDOO_PASSWORD) in package.json metadata

Initial release of Cookidoo skill:

- Access Cookidoo (Thermomix) recipes, shopping lists, and weekly meal plans from the command line.
- View user info, collections, and shopping list ingredients using simple CLI commands.
- Supports JSON output for easy integration with other tools.
- Enables syncing of recipe ingredients to the Bring! shopping list when used with the bring-shopping skill.
- Setup via environment variables; requires active Cookidoo subscription and uses the unofficial cookidoo-api package.
